correctness.rationale: Each quadratic harmonic is a real trace-free 3x3 quadratic form. Its Gaussian moment generator is exactly (1−2s2 z²−8s3 z³/3)^(-1/2); coefficient extraction at every even order yields a polynomial in d=s3²/s2³ with explicitly positive coefficients. A real cubic discriminant gives 0≤d≤1/6 with precisely classified endpoint eigenvalues. Positive first coefficient for all 2m≥6 proves strict order; the fourth moment is constant at 15/7. Independent exact monomial integrals and the packaged checker reproduce 640 moment identities and the 5625/1001,6625/1001 endpoints. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.
